subject: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps

Team —

We have overlapping renewal windows coming up across developer productivity vendors (GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian). I want to avoid duplicate procurement runs and try to consolidate negotiations where it makes sense (single contract owner, one commercial SLA ask, and an aggregated discount ask). High-level asks: 

- Can procurement (Laura) confirm existing seat counts and renewal dates for each vendor by EOD Thu? I have a rough list but need precise SKUs.
- Marissa / Dev: can you confirm whether the current JetBrains floating licenses are still required at current counts — we have a consultant recommendation that some teams can move to individual perpetuals.
- Neha: any known compliance requests (e.g., VPC/on-prem licensing for Atlassian) we should flag?

Attachments: I will circulate a consolidated sheet in follow-ups.

Goal: a single vendor outreach plan + internal decision timeline so we can run a coordinated negotiation and reduce admin overhead. Ideally set a vendor alignment call next week (availability below).

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps

Karthik —

Quick inventory:
- GitHub Enterprise Server (self-hosted): 1200 seats, renews 2027-11-20 (support + entitlements).
- JetBrains All Products Pack (floating): 320 concurrent seats, renews 2027-12-05.
- Atlassian (Jira + Confluence Cloud): 850 users, renews 2027-11-30.

Budget constraints: Q4 spend is tight — we should target consolidated discounts of 18%+ for GitHub and JetBrains and ask Atlassian for committed annual pricing (we can trade committed term for a reduced per-user rate). Procurement notes: we may need Legal to review Atlassian's updated DPA if they push new retention terms.

I'll put together a single sheet with SKUs and a suggested outreach cadence by Thursday. If we want to go to market (RFP) it's >6 weeks; prefer bilateral negotiation with the three vendors first.

-Laura
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Anna Riley <anna@github.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Green <sam.green@consultco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps

Hi Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the heads up and the consolidated ask — happy to coordinate. I attached a preliminary quote for GitHub Enterprise Server ("GitHub-quote-Redwood-2027.pdf"). Key points:

- Current seat count and support tier match our system. We can extend a multi-product discount if JetBrains is part of a co-term negotiation, but we need volume proof for the combined ask.
- We can offer a 15% standard renewal discount, with an additional 3% for a 36-month committed term and 2% if you take our Advanced Support add-on.
- For self-hosted servers, our standard indemnity/limitations are in the quote — Legal redlines tend to be minimal, but we can accept some data residency language if needed.

Let's schedule a 30-min alignment call next Tue (21 Sep) to walk through the consolidated sheet and ask Sam Green (consultant) to help prioritize negotiation levers.

Best,
Anna Riley
Enterprise Sales, GitHub
Anna.Riley@github.com

[Attachment: GitHub-quote-Redwood-2027.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Anna Riley <anna@github.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@consultco.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps

Thanks Anna — attaching the consolidated seat/pricing sheet (Consolidated-seat-pricing-2027.xlsx) and a draft SOW for JetBrains changes (JetBrains-SOW-draft.docx). Notes from engineering review: 

- JetBrains: ~40 seats are assigned to infra/ops where floating licenses are wasteful; proposal from Dev is to convert those 40 to named perpetual licenses (saves ~20% on ongoing costs).
- Atlassian: we need a new audit log retention clause for compliance; Neha please confirm retention window needed for SOC 2 purposes.
- GitHub: engineering asks for an assurance on our ability to delay minor version upgrades; Anna — can we get a short note confirming upgrade window flexibility?

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 9/23: procurement finalizes targets (discount %, term).
- Tue 9/28: vendor calls (GitHub + JetBrains + Atlassian separate 30-min slots).
- Fri 10/8: internal approval and signatures.

Please review attachments and add comments in the Drive link.

Marissa
Director, Developer Productivity
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Consolidated-seat-pricing-2027.xlsx, JetBrains-SOW-draft.docx]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Anna Riley <anna@github.com>, JetBrains Sales <sales@jetbrains.com>, Atlassian Contracts <contracts@atlassian.com>
Cc: Sam Green <sam.green@consultco.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate renewals: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian — timeline & next steps

Thanks everyone for the responses and the materials. Recap & immediate next steps: 

- Laura: finalize target discounts (goal: GitHub 18% total with 36-month term trade, JetBrains 18% with commit, Atlassian committed seat pricing). Please confirm by EOD Thu 9/23.
- Anna / JetBrains / Atlassian: please prepare redline-friendly contracts or a short note on points you cannot accept (data retention, indemnity, upgrade flexibility). If possible, upload to the DocuSign link below so Procurement/Legal can begin parallel review: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123-example
- Marissa & Dev: prepare a short cost-impact memo on converting the 40 JetBrains floats to named licenses — attach to Drive by 9/23.
- Sam: work with Laura to prioritize negotiation levers (bundling vs. term vs. support).

If everyone is aligned, Procurement will lead the bilateral negotiations and aim to have signature-ready docs in early October. Thanks for moving quickly on this — coordinated approach should cut cycle time in half.

Karthik
[Drive folder for attachments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExample]
